tasks.short: Devise automated lab validation test stations.

steps.what: List stored drawings of test fixtures
Devise automated lab validation test stations
Devise other test fixtures or equipment
Sign the station design for this version

outputs: filed copy of signed station design v1

tasks.design: A job lists stored fixture drawings in {DOCS}. The engineer devises the automated lab validation test station and any other fixture or equipment. A later job files the signed design. It does not build the station or change a safety function.
tasks.previous_blocker: Old fixture drawings were hard to find, and the station still has to be devised on the bench.
tasks.enabler_now: Drawings are stored and can be listed.
tasks.still_hard: A safety function on the station is not something a model may change.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer devises the station and signs the design.

ambition.what: Start a station from stored drawings instead of a blank sheet.

tasks.altitude: The engineer spends the week on the station, not on finding old drawings.

reach.task: Build only from the signed design

evidence.claim: The engineering digest says advice, design, and research stay manual, and the signing engineer stays responsible.
Digest [S14] says the Machinery Regulation covers AI safety functions from 20 January 2027, so this design does not let a model change a test-station safety function.

assumptions: The job does not change the live station.
Configure the existing drawing store before a new one.
unknowns: Whether the station includes a safety function.
Who must approve a new fixture.
research_questions: How often a stored drawing is out of date.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining design time is still the engineer on the fixture.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes drawings are poorly indexed. The high end assumes drawings are already listed. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The validation engineer spends the week on the test, the deviation, and the signed decision. Filing a signed record can move. A model does not release a protocol or change a live test station.
reach: Quality staff collect a sample only from the list the engineer signed.
A department starts a test only after the signed schedule is filed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a protocol figure that has no source row.
Leave equipment, sampling, and agency contact as their own work.
role.ambitious_version: A signed protocol or report can be filed the same day, and the engineer still releases it.
